add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.reason: VerifyMessageProperties.java:139 and :145 compile HTML_TAGS `<[a-z]+[^>]*>` and ANCHOR_PATTERN `</?a[^>]*>` case-sensitively, so an uppercase <B>/<A> is not treated as HTML/anchor and the lowercasing sanitizer output differs, reporting 'Illegal HTML'. No message bundle at head uses uppercase tags, and the effect is a stricter build-time check, so it is a minor robustness point.
add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.comment: The theme verifier's HTML and anchor regexes are case-sensitive, so uppercase tags in translations are flagged as illegal HTML by the build.

add-authzclientcryptoprovider-for-author.reason: ASN1Decoder.java:65-74 readInteger checks only readTagNumber(tag) (tag & 0x1f, line 94), so a constructed INTEGER (0x22) is accepted.
